summary: SSR Mining Inc. filed a Form 8-K on October 13, 2026, furnishing a news release and filing a Technical Report Summary (SK 1300) for its Marigold Complex in Nevada under Items 7.01, 8.01 and 9.01. The disclosure covers updated mineral resource and reserve estimates and a qualified person's consent, plus a Regulation FD notice designating the corporate website as a distribution channel. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or regulatory clock is stated. This is a routine operational disclosure and not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
